allIntro:
Complete five missions to explore how language models process text, predict and learn.
Finish all missions to unlock the Final Challenge!
completeAllToUnlock: Complete all 5 missions to unlock the Final Challenge.
finalTitle: Final Challenge: AI Literacy Escape Room
finalDesc: Complete all 5 missions to unlock the final challenge and test your AI knowledge!

1.title: How does a language model process text?

2.title: Which words can a language model see?
2.desc: Explore the context window and the text available to the model.

3.title: Which words help a language model most?
3.desc: Explore how useful clues connect across the current context.

4.title: How does a language model choose what comes next?
4.desc: Compare possible next Tokens, their chances and one-Token-at-a-time generation.

5.title: How does a language model learn from examples?
5.desc: Follow prediction, correction and repetition to see how useful patterns are learned.
